home.title: MigraAid
home.metaDescription: Multilingual rights and support hub for migrant workers in Singapore.
home.tagline: Understand your rights in Singapore — in your language.
home.heroLede: Answers about pay, permits, housing and healthcare, grounded in Singapore law and verified with NGO caseworkers.
home.cardLawBody: Every answer cites the Employment Act, WICA, or MOM guidelines it comes from.
home.cardPrivacyBody: No login, no name. Contract photos are analysed, never stored.
home.disclaimer: MigraAid gives general information, not legal advice. For your specific situation, contact a caseworker at a partner organisation. In an emergency, use the Emergency Contacts page.

footer.independence: MigraAid is an independent, non-commercial project. It is not affiliated with MOM, TADM, or any support organisation.

privacyPage.title: Privacy
privacyPage.intro: MigraAid does not ask who you are. There is no account, no name, and no phone number. This page explains exactly what happens to what you type.
privacyPage.collectBody: Your question and the answer, an anonymous device code, your chosen language, and — only if you tick the box — the summary of a contract you photographed. Before anything is stored, MigraAid removes common identifiers such as email addresses, phone numbers, NRIC/FIN and passport numbers.
privacyPage.providerBody: Your question is sent to OpenAI in the United States to produce the answer. OpenAI may keep it for up to 30 days for abuse monitoring before deleting it. MigraAid removes common identifiers first, but you should still avoid typing names, numbers or addresses.
privacyPage.retentionBody: MigraAid deletes conversations and contract summaries after {days} days, automatically, every night. Only anonymous daily counts are kept longer, and those cannot be linked back to you.
privacyPage.cookieBody: One cookie holds a random code so this device can find and delete its own data. It contains nothing about you, and it expires after {days} days — the same as the data it points to.
privacyPage.rightsBody: You can delete everything from this device at any time using the button below. It takes effect immediately. Note that this works per device: clearing your browser or switching phones means the button can no longer find those conversations, though they are still deleted automatically on schedule.
privacyPage.contactBody: MigraAid is an independent project, not a company or a government service. You can raise a question or a concern through the source repository linked at the bottom of every page.

termsPage.title: Terms of use
termsPage.intro: MigraAid is free to use. These terms are short on purpose.
termsPage.notAdviceHeading: This is information, not legal advice
termsPage.notAdviceBody: MigraAid explains what public sources say about your rights. It is not a lawyer, it does not know your situation, and using it does not create any professional relationship. For advice about your own case, contact one of the organisations on the Emergency page.
termsPage.accuracyBody: Every answer is drawn from official published sources and shows which one it used, so you can check it yourself. Even so, rules change and answers can be out of date or mistaken. Never rely on MigraAid alone for a decision that affects your job, your health, or your right to stay.
termsPage.independenceBody: MigraAid is an independent, non-commercial project. It is not affiliated with, endorsed by, or speaking for the Ministry of Manpower, TADM, or any support organisation, even though it cites their published guidance.
termsPage.useBody: Please use MigraAid to ask genuine questions. Do not try to overload it, break it, or use it to send content that is unlawful or abusive. There is no warranty of any kind, and the service may be unavailable at times.
termsPage.changesBody: These terms may change. The current version is always the one on this page, and the full history is public in the source repository.

safety.ungrounded: I don't have enough verified source information to answer this safely. Please contact a partner organisation or use the Emergency Contacts page if you are in danger.
safety.highStakes: This may seriously affect your rights or safety. I should not advise you on your specific case. Please contact one of the support organisations below as soon as you safely can.
safety.injection: I can only help with questions about migrant-worker rights and services using verified sources. Please rephrase your question without instructions for changing how MigraAid works.
